design: Nodes are tertiles of (1-alpha)*Uniform + alpha*rank(BMI), then subsampled so every node holds the same number of positives and negatives. P(Y) is therefore identical across nodes and only P(X) varies. Reference is the alpha=0 arm of this experiment, at the same cohort size.
motivation: Complement to 49_prevalence_sweep.py, which held P(X|Y) fixed and varied P(Y) and found no effect.
